meta.source: Desk research received by the macro@ mailbox (named houses), read daily by macro-briefing reader.py; statements summarized from each bank's own release
meta.core_note: Real policy rate = (1 + nominal policy rate) / (1 + core inflation over the last 12 months) - 1, each country's core CPI measure read agency-direct (macrolib; for the U.S., CPI ex food and energy, not PCE); India uses headline CPI, which has no official core.

statement.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
statement.summary: Fed raised federal funds rate target 25bp to 3.75-4%, citing elevated inflation and solid growth; signals intent to keep tightening policy to speed return to 2% inflation goal.
statement.quote: Today's policy action will support a timelier return to the Committee's 2 percent goal.

core_inflation.measure: CPI excluding food and energy (BLS, via FRED)

calls.path: one more hike in December possible, could be knocked out if France deteriorates further
calls.note: financial-conditions tightening (yields, French spreads, AI FCI) substituting for hikes; no sign of second-round energy effects

calls.path: expect a December hike, then quarterly cuts from Sep-27
calls.note: dovish tilt as tighter financial conditions offset renewed energy-price risks

calls.path: continue steering markets to deliver currently priced hikes, risks skewed to hiking more
calls.note: following Lagarde's 2023 supply-shock framework, tracking actual consumer energy prices

statement.title: Monetary policy decisions
statement.summary: ECB raised key rates by 25bp to counter Middle East-driven inflation pressures, to 2.50%/2.65%/2.90%. Future decisions will be data-dependent, meeting-by-meeting, with no pre-commitment to a rate path.
statement.quote: The Governing Council is not pre-committing to a particular rate path.

core_inflation.measure: HICP excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco (Eurostat)

calls.path: begin hiking cycle at next meeting, continuing forward guidance similar to prior MPRs (150bp April scenario, 100bp July scenario)
calls.note: energy-shock inflation scenario from April/July MPRs has become the central case

market_quotes.quote: 4.9% BoE peak priced - compared to 5.25% (April) and 4.75% (July) forward guidance

statement.title: Bank rate maintained at 3.75% - September 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
statement.summary: BoE held Bank Rate at 3.75% (6-3 vote), citing energy-driven inflation risks tilted to the upside; stands ready to act if needed. Also voted to unwind QE to zero via gilt sales through 2034.
statement.quote: The Committee stands ready to act as necessary to ensure that CPI inflation remains on track to meet the 2% target in the medium term.
statement.vote: 6-3; three members preferred a 25bp increase to 4%

core_inflation.measure: CPI excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco (ONS)

statement.title: Bank of Canada maintains the policy rate at 2¼%
statement.summary: BoC held the overnight rate at 2.25%. Rate kept steady as growth and inflation tracked forecasts, but rising oil-related inflation risks and new tariffs add uncertainty; Bank stands ready to adjust policy as needed.
statement.quote: Governing Council will assess the sustainability of the economic rebound and the outlook for inflation, and is prepared to adjust monetary policy as needed.

core_inflation.measure: CPI excluding food and energy (Statistics Canada)

calls.path: rates held at 4.85% slightly longer, easing cycle now pushed to 4Q2027 (prior 3Q2027)
calls.note: upside CPI surprise, elevated oil prices, hawkish RBA commentary

statement.title: Statement by the Monetary Policy Board: Monetary Policy Decision
statement.summary: RBA raised the cash rate 25bp to 4.60% amid elevated inflation from energy prices and capacity pressures. Signals readiness to hike further if needed to return inflation to target.
statement.quote: The Board will continue to do what it considers necessary to bring inflation sustainably back to target, including increasing the cash rate target further if needed.

core_inflation.measure: Trimmed mean CPI, monthly (ABS; the RBA's measure)

statement.title: 2026-09-24 - Monetary policy assessment of 24 September 2026
statement.summary: SNB kept its policy rate unchanged at 0%, citing rising inflation from energy prices but only slightly higher medium-term pressure; it remains ready to intervene in forex markets as needed.
statement.quote: The forecast is based on the assumption that the SNB policy rate is 0% over the entire forecast horizon.

core_inflation.measure: Core inflation 1: CPI ex fresh and seasonal products, energy and fuel (FSO)

statement.title: Policy rate unchanged at 1.75 per cent
statement.summary: Riksbank held rate at 1.75%, but signals larger-than-expected hikes ahead due to strong growth and supply shocks, with increases likely starting before year-end.
statement.quote: If the outlook for inflation and economic activity remains unchanged, it is expected that the increases to the policy rate will begin this year.

core_inflation.measure: CPIF excluding energy (Statistics Sweden; the Riksbank's measure)

statement.title: Policy rate raised to 4.50%
statement.summary: Norges Bank raised its policy rate from 4.25% to 4.50%, expects to keep rates elevated longer than previously signaled, and remains ready to hike further if inflation stays persistently above target.
statement.quote: It will likely be necessary to keep the policy rate elevated for a time, and the Committee is prepared to raise the policy rate further if needed to bring inflation down to the 2% target within a reasonable time horizon

core_inflation.measure: CPI-ATE: ex energy, adjusted for taxes (Statistics Norway; Norges Bank's measure)

calls.path: final 25bp hike expected in March to 3.25%, peak below current market pricing of 3.75% by Aug 2027
calls.note: RBNZ held in October 4-3 split but guided to further increases

market_quotes.quote: ahead of the meeting, financial markets had priced in 24.4bp of tightening
market pricing suggesting a ~98% probability of a hike

statement.title: OCR increased by 25 basis points to 2.75%
statement.summary: OCR increased by 25 basis points to 2.75%.
statement.note: statement text not readable by automation; the release title stands in for a summary

core_inflation.measure: CPI ex food, household energy and vehicle fuels, quarterly (Stats NZ)

statement.title: Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations
statement.summary: BOJ raised policy rate 25bp to around 1.25%, citing inflation nearing 2% target. Signals continued gradual rate hikes ahead, pace dependent on data including Middle East and FX impacts.
statement.quote: the Bank will continue to raise the policy interest rate and adjust the degree of monetary accommodation, in response to developments in economic activity and prices as well as financial conditions.
statement.vote: 7-2; two members preferred maintaining the previous guideline

core_inflation.measure: CPI excluding fresh food (Statistics Bureau; the BoJ's 'core')

statement.title: Announcement on Loan Prime Rate (October 20, 2026)
statement.summary: PBOC kept the one-year LPR at 3.0% and the over-five-year LPR at 3.5%, unchanged, effective until the next monthly release.
statement.quote: The rates are effective until the next release.

core_inflation.measure: CPI excluding food and energy (National Bureau of Statistics)

statement.title: Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) October 5 to 7, 2026
statement.summary: RBI's MPC unanimously raised the repo rate 25bp to 5.50% and shifted stance to 'calibrated tightening,' signaling rate cuts are off the table near term; next move is a hike or pause.
statement.quote: It only signals that given the current conditions, rate cuts are off the table in the near term and policy action ahead can only be a rate hike or a pause.
statement.vote: 6-0 on rate; on stance, two members (Dr. Nagesh Kumar, Prof. Ram Singh) preferred retaining neutral stance

core_inflation.measure: HEADLINE CPI — India publishes no official core measure (MoSPI)
